Package index

Overview

oxyproxy oxyproxy-package
oxyproxy: Steady-State Mass Balance Model of Oxygen Flux in Animal Body Water

d18O body water model

Estimate oxygen-18 enrichment of animal body water from oxygen inputs and outputs.

species_function()
Calculates water and oxygen fluxes as affected by species physiology.
food_function()
Calculates water and oxygen fluxes as affected by species diet
environment_function()
Calculates water and oxygen fluxes as affected by environmental conditions
input_function()
Calculates all variables of oxygen input from physiology, diet, and environment.
outputs_function()
Calculates all variables of oxygen input from physiology and diet.
d18_obw_function()
Calculate estimate of oxygen-18 enrichment of animal bodywater based on flux of oxygen input and outputs.
oxy_proxy_function()
Plots estimates of oxygen-18 enrichment of animal bodywater based on flux of oxygen input and outputs against variables input by user.

Relative humidity estimation

Invert the model to estimate relative humidity from a measured d18O enamel carbonate value.

d18O_enamel()
Convert values of oxygen-18 enrichment found within samples of the carbonate (CO3) component of animal tooth enamel to analogous values representing isotopic enrichment of animal body water.
rh_estimation_environment_function()
Calculates water and oxygen fluxes as affected by environmental conditions.
inverse_input_function()
Calculate all variables of oxygen input from physiology, diet, and environment.
rh_function()
Calculates estimates of relative humidity and variables that are dependent on values of relative humidity that are needed to calculate oxygen-18 enrichment of animal body water.
humidity_oxy_proxy()
Plots estimated values of relative humidity converted from measurements of d18Oenamel-carbonate.
